recipes.title: Cauliflower and Chickpea Curry

recipe.title: Cauliflower and Chickpea Curry
recipe.description: A hearty, spiced curry featuring urgent cauliflower and protein‑rich chickpeas, simmered in a fragrant tomato‑garam masala sauce.
instructions: Rinse the dried chickpeas, place them in a bowl, cover with water and soak for at least 4 hours (or overnight).
Drain the chickpeas, transfer to a pot, add fresh water, bring to a boil, then simmer on medium heat for 45 minutes, until tender; drain and set aside.
Cut the cauliflower into florets (about 2 cm pieces).
Blanch the cauliflower florets in boiling water for 3 minutes, then drain and set aside.
Dice the tomatoes.
Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add 1 tsp ground cumin and sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the diced tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring, until they break down and become saucy.
Stir in 2 tsp garam masala and cook 1 minute, watching for a deep, aromatic brown color.
Add the blanched cauliflower florets and the cooked chickpeas, mix well.
Pour in 400 ml coconut milk, bring to a gentle simmer, lower to a soft boil and cook for 12 minutes, until the cauliflower is tender and the sauce thickens.
Season with salt to taste, garnish with fresh cilantro if desired, and serve hot.
tips: If you run short on time, use canned chickpeas (rinsed) instead of dried; adjust cook time accordingly.
A squeeze of lemon juice at the end brightens the flavors.
recipe.image_prompt: Professional food photography, bright orange cauliflower chickpea curry in a copper bowl, fresh cilantro garnish, natural light

issues: Les étapes ne précisent pas les quantités (ex: 'Cut the cauliflower' au lieu de 'Cut the 1 cauliflower').
La recette utilise des ingrédients absents du garde-manger (lait de coco, cumin, huile) sans justification.
L'étape 1 ne précise pas la quantité d'eau pour le trempage.
strengths: La gestion du temps de cuisson des pois chiches est rigoureuse et sécuritaire.
L'ordre des opérations est logique et permet une exécution fluide.

recipes.title: Spiced Potato & Tomato Basmati Pilaf

recipe.title: Spiced Potato & Tomato Basmati Pilaf
recipe.description: Fluffy basmati rice cooked with golden potatoes, ripe tomatoes and garam masala, a light yet satisfying dinner dish.
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice under cold water until the water runs clear; soak for 10 minutes, then drain.
Peel the potatoes and cut them into 1‑cm dice.
Dice the tomatoes.
Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a saucepan over medium heat. Add 1 tsp cumin seeds and let them sizzle for 20 seconds until they start to pop.
Add the diced potatoes, sauté for 5 minutes, stirring, until the edges turn lightly golden.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, 1/2 tsp turmeric and 1 tsp garam masala; cook for 3 minutes, until the tomatoes soften.
Add the drained rice, gently toast for 2 minutes, stirring to coat each grain with the spices.

Pour in 500 ml water, bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a gentle simmer (low heat). Cover the pan with a tight lid and cook for 12 minutes, until the rice is fluffy and all liquid is absorbed.
Remove from heat, let stand covered for 5 minutes, then fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve.
tips: For extra aroma, add a small cinnamon stick to the water; remove before serving.
A handful of frozen peas can be tossed in with the tomatoes for a pop of colour.
recipe.image_prompt: Professional food photography, golden basmati pilaf with tender potato cubes and juicy tomato pieces, garnished with cilantro, rustic plate, soft natural light

issues: Les quantités ne sont pas rappelées dans les étapes (ex: 'Peel the potatoes' sans préciser les 3 pommes de terre).
Utilisation d'ingrédients non listés dans le garde-manger (curcuma, cumin, huile).
L'étape 1 ne précise pas la quantité de riz à rincer.
strengths: La technique de cuisson du riz pilaf est maîtrisée et respecte les standards de la cuisine indienne.
Le temps de repos final est une excellente pratique pour la texture du riz.

recipes.title: Cauliflower‑Potato Tikka Masala (Vegan)

recipe.title: Cauliflower‑Potato Tikka Masala (Vegan)
recipe.description: A creamy, mildly spiced tikka masala using cauliflower and potatoes as the main vegetables, finished with a coconut‑based sauce.
instructions: Cut the cauliflower into bite‑size florets.
Peel the potatoes and cut them into 1‑cm cubes.
Blend the single tomato into a smooth puree.
Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Add the potato cubes and sauté for 6 minutes, stirring, until they start to turn golden.
Add the cauliflower florets, continue sautéing for another 5 minutes, until the cauliflower begins to soften.
Stir in 1 tsp ground coriander and 1.5 tsp garam masala; cook for 1 minute, watching for a deep, fragrant brown hue.
Pour in the tomato puree, mix well, and let it simmer for 4 minutes, until the mixture thickens slightly.
Add 300 ml coconut milk, bring the sauce to a gentle boil, then lower to a soft simmer and cook for 12 minutes, until the potatoes are fully cooked and the sauce is rich and glossy.
Season with salt to taste, garnish with fresh cilantro if available, and serve hot with basmati rice or flatbread.
tips: If you prefer a thicker sauce, mash a few potatoes against the side of the pan before adding coconut milk.
A pinch of smoked paprika adds a subtle smoky note without breaking the vegan rule.

issues: Absence systématique des quantités dans les étapes de préparation.
Utilisation d'ingrédients non fournis dans le garde-manger (lait de coco, coriandre, huile).
L'étape 3 ne précise pas la quantité de tomates à mixer.
strengths: La méthode de cuisson des légumes en deux temps (pommes de terre puis chou-fleur) assure une texture homogène.
La consigne de faire réduire la purée de tomates avant d'ajouter le lait de coco est techniquement juste.
